boundary: Operational and synthetic workflow evidence only; failed witnesses remain retained and same-owner passing witnesses are not independent reproduction.

records.failed_witness: A guessed memory shell helper was unavailable in the active surface.
records.passing_witness: The memory registry and one exact rollout summary were read from their declared paths.
records.recovery: Use the provided filesystem and shell tools for the bounded memory pass.
records.recurrence_guard: Use only callable tools visible in the current turn.
records.rollback: The unavailable helper changed nothing and earned zero read credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use the current callable surface rather than recalling a stale helper name.

records.failed_witness: The first Git probe ran from the nonrepository Codex metadata directory and returned not a git repository.
records.passing_witness: Exact source and lane probes returned their intended branches and heads.
records.recovery: Bind every Git command to Tamar's exact source worktree or Elowen's owned worktree.
records.recurrence_guard: Resolve the repository root before any Git operation.
records.rollback: Credit no Git result from an unrelated directory.
records.sibling_recommendation: Bind Git commands with an explicit verified worktree.

records.failed_witness: The first activation projection exceeded its visible output bound.
records.passing_witness: All activation ranges were read through EOF.
records.recovery: Read the committed baton in bounded exact windows through EOF.
records.recurrence_guard: Measure long artifacts before displaying and page them deterministically.
records.rollback: No truncated projection earns read-through credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use bounded windows for long batons.

records.failed_witness: A later activation projection covering the middle section also truncated.
records.passing_witness: The missing middle range was read in smaller windows.
records.recovery: Reduce only the failed window and continue sequentially.
records.recurrence_guard: Track exact missing intervals after every truncation.
records.rollback: Retain the failed projection and do not restart successful ranges.
records.sibling_recommendation: Recover only the missing interval.

records.failed_witness: A final large activation window near the end also truncated.
records.passing_witness: The tail and EOF were read completely.
records.recovery: Split the tail into smaller exact windows.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep each projection below the current output limit.
records.rollback: The truncated tail earns zero credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use smaller tail windows and verify EOF.

records.failed_witness: A stale Method Flow schema filename guess did not exist.
records.passing_witness: The current Method Flow skill and schema were read completely.
records.recovery: Inventory the selected skill directory and open the actual schema reference.
records.recurrence_guard: Never infer schema filenames from older phases.
records.rollback: The missing-path guess changed nothing.
records.sibling_recommendation: Inventory current skill files before opening references.

records.failed_witness: A stale Reflection Remaster schema filename guess did not exist.
records.passing_witness: The complete current skill and its real schema were read.

records.recurrence_guard: Treat filenames as discoverable state, not memory.
records.rollback: The missing-path guess earns no skill-read credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use rg --files before schema reads.

records.failed_witness: A raw full-roster display was overbroad and exceeded the useful bound.
records.passing_witness: The validator confirmed fifteen main tasks and Tavian on standby; Elowen's successor is Sylven.
records.recovery: Run the roster validator and project only current seat, successor, endpoint kind, controller, and standby facts.
records.recurrence_guard: Use schema-aware scalar projections for route state.
records.rollback: The broad display authorizes no route action.
records.sibling_recommendation: Validate first, then project bounded routing facts.

records.failed_witness: The first skill inventory mixed JavaScript-style escaping with PowerShell and caused a parser fault.
records.passing_witness: All selected skills, schemas, and guidance files were inventoried and read.
records.recovery: Use literal PowerShell paths and materialized arrays.
records.recurrence_guard: Avoid cross-language escaping in one shell expression.
records.rollback: The parser fault changed no file.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use one language's quoting rules per command.

records.failed_witness: The first divergence projection treated a formatted zero-tab-zero payload as one integer and failed conversion.
records.passing_witness: The isolated checks proved 0 ahead and 0 behind.
records.recovery: Query ahead and behind as separate scalar counts and parse each as an integer.
records.recurrence_guard: Never parse formatted divergence output as a scalar integer.
records.rollback: The failed conversion earns zero divergence credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use typed scalar ahead and behind probes.

records.failed_witness: A combined external receipt and full-manifest display exceeded the output budget.
records.passing_witness: The canonical receipt and all three manifests matched their exact digests, paths, modes, blobs, sizes, and content hashes.
records.recovery: Hash the exact receipt and compare each manifest through bounded programmatic summaries.
records.recurrence_guard: Avoid displaying full exact manifests when scalar comparison proves equality.
records.rollback: The truncated wrapper earns zero receipt or manifest credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer literal receipt allowlists and concise exact comparisons.

records.failed_witness: The first canonical summary projected a nonexistent test_count key.
records.passing_witness: The real receipt structure showed 54 tests and all declared component counts.
records.recovery: Inspect the actual receipt keys before selecting test records.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect schemas and object keys before projections.
records.rollback: The stale field assumption earns zero validation credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Project only observed receipt keys.

records.failed_witness: The first broad manifest comparison wrapper returned no attributable output within its window.
records.passing_witness: X1, source-to-evidence, and source-to-final manifests matched exactly.
records.recovery: Use a bounded batch comparison and emit one scalar summary per manifest.
records.recurrence_guard: Drain batch pipes and emit concise results.
records.rollback: The unattributable wrapper earns zero comparison credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use deterministic bulk Git plumbing with attributable summaries.

records.failed_witness: A broad parallel read of source documents truncated and obscured which documents were complete.
records.passing_witness: Every required Tamar source class was read or exactly parsed.
records.recovery: Read exact required documents separately and use structural parsers for complete ledgers.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep document identity attributable in every read.
records.rollback: The truncated combined read earns no completion credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Read and report each exact source class independently.

records.failed_witness: The sparse-lane command included an invalid Join-Path invocation and inspected cleanliness before sparse materialization, showing 73,518 apparent deletions.

records.recurrence_guard: Treat --no-checkout state as transitional and never recreate the lane after a recoverable setup fault.
records.rollback: The premature status and Join-Path fault earn zero cleanliness credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Configure sparse patterns, materialize once, and only then inspect status.

records.rollback: The shape mismatch earns zero novelty credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Inspect object keys before corpus aggregation.
